subject: Recap & SOC 2 packet — next steps and any blockers
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@chartersoft.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & SOC 2 packet — next steps and any blockers

Alex — great to meet today. Quick recap so we're aligned and you have everything for your security review: 

- Goal: get CharterSoft comfortable with Redwood to start a pilot (2k qps budgeted for July)
- Scope: hosted API for inference, dedicated VLAN option if you need network isolation
- Ask from Charter: SOC 2 evidence, encryption/QoS details, and a list of deployment controls

I attached our SOC 2 packet (redwood_soc2_packet_v2.pdf) and uploaded the same bundle to the Drive link below in case your security team prefers that. Next steps I proposed on the call: 
1) Your security team reviews SOC 2 packet (timeline: 1–2 weeks)
2) If there are blockers, we schedule a 30-min tech sync with our infra security engineer
3) Commercial: I’ll follow up on pricing/term questions after the security check is nominal

Can you confirm who on your side will own the review and whether this timeline still works? If it helps, we can offer a short office-hours window with our security engineer next Tue/Thu.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3SOcj-SOC2-CH-2027-058
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/CH-2027-058

Thanks,
Soojin Lee

soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0193

Alex — just adding Laura (our Solutions Architect) to the thread so she has context for any tech follow-ups. I also uploaded a couple of extra artifacts your team sometimes asks for (network diagram + retention summary) to the Drive folder.

If your security lead prefers an emailed bundle instead of Drive, tell me and I'll send a single ZIP. Otherwise, please share a preferred time for the technical Q&A if any items are flagged — we can do a 30-min slot next week.

Laura — FYI, CharterSoft is evaluating for a July pilot; security lead is Priya Shah per Alex.

Thanks,
Soojin

Soojin —

If we don't hear back by EOD Thursday, propose we: 
- Offer a concrete 30-min tech QA window (Tue/Wed next week) and propose 3 time slots in a follow-up email to Alex
- Share a one-page summary that maps their ask list to our packet (to reduce back-and-forth)

Sorry for the radio silence — we've been swamped with a quarterly audit. I shared the packet with our security team; Priya is leading the review. They have one item they'd like clarified: data retention defaults for ephemeral KV cache and whether we can configure a 24-hour TTL instead of the default. I attached our questions doc.

Can we do a 30-min sync next Tue (Jun 15) at 10:00 AM PT to walk through? If Priya needs anything ahead of the call, let me know and I'll surface.

Thanks,
Alex
